<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Make RPC and service-peer semantic convention selection instance-scoped, so separately configured `OpenTelemetry` instances can emit different conventions in the same JVM.

The internal `SemconvStability` RPC/service-peer selection helpers and `rpcSchemaUrl` now require an explicit instance:

```diff
-SemconvStability.emitOldRpcSemconv()
+SemconvStability.emitOldRpcSemconv(openTelemetry)
-SemconvStability.rpcSchemaUrl()
+SemconvStability.rpcSchemaUrl(openTelemetry)
```

RPC factory signatures such as `RpcClientMetrics.get()` and `RpcSpanNameExtractor.create(getter)` remain unchanged. Instrumentations initialize RPC components with their owning `OpenTelemetry` instance; uninitialized components retain a global fallback. An initialized component cannot be rebound to a different instance.

AWS RPC extractors are instance-owned. Span names, attributes, metrics, and schema URLs follow the same selection. Legacy child metrics no longer inherit a dual-emitting parent's method.

Database, messaging, and code conventions remain unchanged.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Fixes #20135

<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Make RPC and service-peer semantic convention selection instance-scoped, so separately configured `OpenTelemetry` instances can emit different conventions in the same JVM.

For 3.0, remove global-backed RPC factories and the no-argument RPC/service-peer selection helpers. Pass the instrumentation's `OpenTelemetry` instance instead:

```diff
-RpcClientMetrics.get()
+RpcClientMetrics.get(openTelemetry)
-RpcSpanNameExtractor.create(getter)
+RpcSpanNameExtractor.create(getter, openTelemetry)
-SemconvStability.emitOldRpcSemconv()
+SemconvStability.emitOldRpcSemconv(openTelemetry)
```

The client/server attribute extractors, server metrics, dual-emission context customizer, remaining RPC/service-peer selection helpers, and `rpcSchemaUrl` likewise require an explicit instance.

RPC consumers pass their own instance, and AWS RPC extractors are instance-owned. Span names, attributes, metrics, and schema URLs follow the same selection. Legacy child metrics no longer inherit a dual-emitting parent's method.

Database, messaging, and code conventions remain unchanged.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Fixes #20135
